title: unify-deploymentProfiles-add-init-probe-templating-and-rollback-safepoint
author: Sofia Martinez
ci_status: pass (lint fixed after one flaky helm-template rerun)
body:
Context and motivation: Private deployments currently encode environment-specific differences (onprem vs VPC) across several values keys and templates which makes upgrades and templating brittle for tenant-init jobs and rollback safety. This PR introduces a compact 'deploymentProfiles' values structure to consolidate environment variations, adds a templated init liveness/probe helper (so operators can tune job readiness without forking templates), and implements a lightweight rollback-safepoint annotation + Helm test that prevents rolling back to charts that would skip an irreversible init step.

What this PR does (single-string description): - Add top-level values.deploymentProfiles with two example profiles (onprem, vpc) and a mechanism to extend profiles per-customer. - Introduce charts/private/templates/_helpers.tpl helpers: deploymentProfile, initProbe, initParallelism, rolloutFenceAnnotation. These helpers centralize logic previously duplicated in init-job and connector templates. - Replace inline probe/parallelism logic in templates/init-job.yaml with calls to initProbe and initParallelism. - Add templates/rollback-fence.yaml which injects a chart annotation (redwood.io/rollback-safepoint) when init steps require a safepoint and a templates/tests/test-rollback.yaml helm test that fails if safepoint annotations change incompatibly. - Update values.schema.json to validate deploymentProfiles shape and probe/parallelism knobs. - Update charts/private/README.md with migration notes and recommended profile examples.

Upgrade and migration notes: Operators should map their existing onprem/vpc overrides into the new values.deploymentProfiles map (see README examples). The default behavior preserves existing values if legacy keys are present (back-compat code path kept for one release). For canary upgrades we recommend running the helm test (helm test <release> -l helm.sh/chart=redwood-private) to validate rollback fences before switching traffic.

Checklist: - [x] Add values schema and readme updates - [x] Centralize helpers in _helpers.tpl - [x] Swap templates to use helpers - [x] Add helm test for rollback-safepoint - [x] CI: run lint, helm-template, and integration e2e smoke (flaky e2e retried once)

Related work: follows up on prior init orchestration PRs and addresses Linear items ENG-4120 (consolidate private values) and ENG-4187 (rollback safety for tenant-init). Supports support ticket SUP-523 where customer caused a rollback that reintroduced a schema-incompatible init path.

Notes for reviewers: focus on the values.schema shape and _helpers.tpl semantics; the init job YAML change is intentionally minimal and delegates to helpers. The rollback test is intentionally conservative (it only prevents accidental removal of a safepoint annotation unless explicitly opted-out).
commits: c1f3b2f: introduce deploymentProfiles shape and migration shim
a9d4e0c: add _helpers.tpl with deploymentProfile and initProbe helpers
b72e6aa: refactor init-job to use helpers and parameterize parallelism
d0f98f1: add rollback-fence annotation injection and helm test
f3a7c12: update values.schema.json and README with examples
e4b9a77: fix linting and adjust helm-template output for cluster-scoped resources
review_comments: Ethan Zhao: Looks good overall. Can we ensure the migration shim logs a deprecation warning during helm upgrade?
Sofia Martinez: Added a small notes field and preserved legacy keys; logging during helm upgrade isn't native, documented recommendation added to README instead.
Priya Nair: The helm test is useful but might be noisy in CI for backports. Can we gate it behind .Values.tests.enable?
Sofia Martinez: Added .Values.tests.enable check and defaulted to true in values.yaml; CI workflow will explicitly set it as needed.
Liam O'Connor: initProbe helper looks good. Consider lowering default failureThreshold for tenants with flaky storage mounts.
Sofia Martinez: lowered failureThreshold default to 3 and documented per-profile overrides. Marking as approved.
Ethan Zhao: Approved - minor nits addressed.
ci_checks: helm-template: pass (re-ran after template ordering fix)
release_notes: Introduce deploymentProfiles for private charts, add templated init probe and parallelism helpers, and add a rollback-safepoint annotation plus helm test to prevent accidental incompatible rollbacks. Operators should migrate per README; legacy keys are supported for one release.
notes_for_ops: If you rely on custom init-job overrides, migrate them into deploymentProfiles.<profileName>.init where possible. Run 'helm template' and the provided helm test before upgrading. For air-gapped installs, verify the chart tests locally using helm install --dry-run.
changelog_summary: values: add deploymentProfiles; templates: move probe/parallelism logic to helpers; test: add rollback-fence helm test
estimated_risk: medium (templating refactor affects init sequencing; migration shim keeps back-compat)
